66acca1a7e45e.description: Fresh, creamy, and full of vibrant flavors, our Guacamole is made with ripe avocados, zesty lime, and a blend of cilantro, tomatoes, and onions. Perfectly seasoned with a pinch of salt and a hint of spice, it’s the ultimate dip for your chips or a delicious accompaniment to any meal. Served with a side of crispy tortilla chips, this classic favorite is the perfect balance of creamy, tangy, and savory. Made fresh daily—it's a crowd-pleasing treat that never goes out of style!

66b0ac9bbe5e1.description: A classic Italian favorite, our Spaghetti Bolognese features al dente spaghetti topped with a rich, slow-cooked meat sauce made from tender ground beef, tomatoes, onions, garlic, and a blend of aromatic herbs. Simmered to perfection, this hearty sauce delivers layers of deep, savory flavors, perfectly complemented by a sprinkle of Parmesan cheese. A comforting and satisfying dish that brings the taste of Italy straight to your plate!
66b0ac9bbe5e1.name: Spaghetti Bolognese

66b0ca438f3a5.name: Macaroni
66b0ca438f3a5.description: Comfort food at its finest! Our Macaroni features perfectly cooked elbow pasta enveloped in a creamy, cheddar cheese sauce made with premium ingredients for a smooth, velvety finish. This classic dish is baked to golden perfection, with a crispy, cheesy topping that adds just the right amount of crunch. Whether you enjoy it as a satisfying side or a main, it's the ultimate cozy dish, made to warm your heart and satisfy your cravings. Add your choice of protein or vegetables for a personalized touch to make it your own!

66b0bd412145f.description: Crispy, golden, and perfectly seasoned, our Onion Rings are the ultimate crispy snack. Made with fresh, thick-cut onions, each ring is coated in a light, crunchy batter and fried to perfection for a satisfying crunch in every bite. Served with a side of tangy dipping sauce, they’re the perfect accompaniment to any meal or a delicious treat all on their own. Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside—these onion rings are a must-try!
66b0bd412145f.name: Onion Rings

66b0d9d4d4081.name: Chips and Salsa
66b0d9d4d4081.description: Crisp, golden tortilla chips paired with our freshly made salsa—a perfect snack for any occasion. Our salsa is bursting with vibrant flavors from ripe tomatoes, zesty lime, cilantro, and a hint of spice, giving you the perfect balance of tangy and savory. Served warm and crunchy, these chips are made for dipping and sharing with friends. Whether you're enjoying a drink or just craving something light, our Chips and Salsa will hit the spot every time!

66b22214b3ec0.name: Lentil Burger
66b22214b3ec0.description: A hearty and delicious plant-based option, our Lentil Burger is made with a savory blend of lentils, spices, and fresh vegetables, all perfectly seasoned and grilled to a satisfying texture. Served on a toasted bun with crisp lettuce, ripe tomatoes, and a tangy sauce, this burger offers a burst of flavor in every bite. Whether you're a vegan or just looking for a lighter, yet filling alternative, our Lentil Burger is the perfect choice for a satisfying meal that’s full of flavor and good for you.

66b0932543a77.description: Warm, crispy flour tortillas filled with a delicious blend of melted cheese and your choice of fresh fillings. Whether you go for tender grilled chicken, savory beef, or vibrant vegetables, our quesadillas are grilled to perfection, offering a satisfying combination of gooey cheese and flavorful fillings. Served with a side of creamy guacamole, zesty salsa, and cool sour cream for the ultimate bite. Perfect for a quick lunch or a flavorful snack that will leave you craving more.
66b0932543a77.name: Quesadillas

66b221431e229.description: A timeless classic, our Margherita Pizza features a perfectly crisp, thin crust topped with rich tomato sauce, creamy mozzarella, and fresh basil leaves. Each bite is a harmonious balance of simple, high-quality ingredients, drizzled with a touch of extra virgin olive oil for that perfect finish. Light, flavorful, and always satisfying—this pizza is a true celebration of authentic Italian flavors.
